name: Diksat Transworld Limited
about: Diksat Transworld Limited engages in the media and entertainment broadcasting business in India. It owns and operates WIN TV, a Tamil news and current affairs channel; ASSERVATHAM TV, a Tamil devotional and religious channel; WIN TV UP, a 24/7 Hindi news and current affairs channel; and CUISINE TV, a 24/7 news and current affairs channel. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Chennai, India.
